## Summary

Describe the trigger, changed behavior and remaining limitations.

## Test Plan

List exact commands and real results. Mark unexecuted checks NOT RUN.

## Requirement IDs

List canonical IDs and update docs/REQUIREMENT_TRACKER.md with evidence.

## Screenshots

Include only real captures, or state none were produced.

## Risk

Describe permissions, device dependence, compatibility and rollback.

A human approval is required before merge. This checklist is not an enforced
branch-protection rule; configure the repository rule separately.
